stage.almost: Almost there, putting the kettle on…

wakeUp.description: Hogar takes a nap when nobody's around, so waking up can take up to a minute. Thanks for waiting!

tips.inviteLink: Invite the people you live with by sharing a link. No emails needed.
tips.weights: Give each person a weight in the household settings and every expense splits in that proportion.
tips.exactCents: Splits always add up to the exact cent, so nobody ends up a cent short.
tips.customSplit: One expense works differently? Change how it's split right in the expense form.
tips.settleUp: Paid someone back? Record the payment and everyone's balance updates.
tips.fixMistakes: Got an expense wrong? Open it to edit or delete it.
tips.guests: Guests can see everything but change nothing. Handy for someone staying a while.
tips.movedOut: When someone moves out, their past expenses stay in the history.
tips.darkTheme: Prefer it darker? Switch to the dark theme from your account menu.
tips.language: Hogar speaks English and Spanish. Switch any time from your account menu.

slow.title: This is taking longer than usual
slow.description: Your home may still be waking up. Give it another go in a moment.

offline.title: You seem to be offline
offline.description: We'll carry on as soon as you're back online.
